title: FALCON-S: Fixed-wing ground-effect Aerodynamics Simulator and Flight Control Learning Suite
abstract: arXiv:2609.06046v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We present a modular, high-fidelity simulation framework for the development and benchmarking of flight control strategies in fixed-wing aerial robots operating near the ground. Unlike existing simulators that rely on simplified or hover-oriented dynamics, our framework models full 6DoF rigid-body physics, semi-empirical ground-effect aerodynamics, actuator dynamics, sensor noise, and environmental disturbances. This physical realism, combined with modular component design, enables systematic analysis of low-altitude flight behavior under realistic conditions. The simulator supports both CPU and GPU backends via Torch and NVIDIA Warp, enabling high-throughput parallel execution suitable for large-scale reinforcement learning training and optimal control rollouts. A unified interface accommodates a range of controllers (both RL and optical control algorithms) across tasks such as altitude regulation and trajectory tracking. Cross-valida

translated_title: FALCON-S：固定翼地效空气动力学仿真器与飞行控制学习套件
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一个模块化、高保真的仿真框架，用于开发和基准测试在近地面运行的固定翼飞行机器人的飞行控制策略。与现有依赖简化动力学或面向悬停动力学的仿真器不同，我们的框架建模了完整的六自由度刚体物理、半经验地效空气动力学、执行器动力学、传感器噪声和环境扰动。这种物理真实性结合模块化组件设计，能够系统性地分析真实条件下的低空飞行行为。该仿真器通过 Torch 和 NVIDIA Warp 支持 CPU 和 GPU 双后端，可实现高吞吐量并行执行，适用于大规模强化学习训练和最优控制推演。统一的接口可适配多种控制器（包括强化学习和最优控制算法），用于高度调节和轨迹跟踪等任务。
tldr: 本文提出了FALCON-S，一个高保真、模块化的固定翼近地面飞行仿真框架，完整建模六自由度物理与半经验地效空气动力学，并支持CPU/GPU高吞吐量并行计算，可用于大规模强化学习训练和最优控制算法的开发与基准测试。
en_tdlr: This paper presents FALCON-S, a modular high-fidelity simulation framework for fixed-wing low-altitude flight that models full 6DoF physics and semi-empirical ground-effect aerodynamics, with CPU/GPU high-throughput parallel computing support for large-scale reinforcement learning training and optimal control benchmarking.
